mode.description: Canonical run mode: ask and plan are read-only, agent writes. Strategy controls are separate schema-owned fields, never modes.

prompt_sha256.description: sha256 hex digest of the prompt text.

prompt_bytes.description: UTF-8 byte length of the prompt text.

JournaledRunCreatedPayload.description: Journaled `run.created` payload: the prompt text is replaced by its sha256 digest and byte length in the global/project journal partition; the per-run event log keeps the prompt.
